His posture is upright with level shoulders, facing the camera directly, while his head is turned sharply to the left in a strict profile. His sleek, slicked-back hair reflects the intense light, and vintage sunglasses obscure his eyes as he looks away with a serious, deliberately posed expression, his mouth resting in a closed, neutral line. Both of his hands are tucked away, resting relaxed in his suit pockets as he stands isolated against a {argument name="background" default="deeply spacious, minimal coastal background"}. The top and midground are dominated by a pristine, sky blue expanse completely devoid of clouds, meeting a dark ocean blue at the bottom of the frame that is subtly textured with gentle waves along a perfectly clear horizon line. The scene conveys a confident, formal isolation driven by {argument name="lighting style" default="harsh, highly directional natural sunlight striking from the top right"}. This bright, hard light establishes a dramatic, cool, and high-contrast color palette, casting deep black, harshly defined short shadows directly under his chin, beneath his nose, and across the left side of his face. Conversely, crisp specular highlights are meticulously preserved on the right side of his face, his hair, and his right shoulder, with absolutely no ambient fill to soften the intense blacks and vibrant blues. Captured on an 85mm lens as a realistic digital editorial photograph from a straight-on perspective, the tack-sharp image features a medium depth of field with zero grain, utilizing camera settings of ISO 100, f/5.6, and 1/1000s. The classic fashion photography influence is finalized by post-processing that applies a high contrast curve, a blue channel saturation boost, and crisp sharpening to highlight the subtle warm skin tones, with the entire composition gracefully framed in a 4:5 aspect ratio.
